approved_use: Free, no-account, permitted automated US stock/ETF option research; actual BBO prices and side sizes with causal timestamps at most five seconds old. No broker orders or new spending.

requirements.market: US listed stock and ETF options

providers.title: MarketData unauthenticated demonstration
providers.authentication: No token for historical AAPL demonstration only; broader/current API access requires an authenticated entitlement.
providers.latency: Unauthenticated demonstration is historical. Free/trial account documentation specifies at least 24-hour-delayed data, not five-second quotes.
providers.quote_semantics: Option responses document bid, ask, side sizes, daily volume, prior-session open interest and updated snapshot time. A snapshot time is not an independently established exchange-event clock for each side.
providers.automated_use: The vendor documents its API and unlocked historical demonstration. This does not grant current data access or establish a reliability SLA.
blockers: No-account entitlement is historical AAPL only.
Current free no-account actual BBO within five seconds is not established.
Actual response clocks, metric publication clocks and full gate evidence have not been qualified.

providers.title: Tradier brokerage market data
providers.authentication: Brokerage account or approved partner/advisor access and API token are required.
providers.latency: Realtime US equities/options for brokerage access; sandbox data is delayed 15 minutes.
providers.quote_semantics: Documented market data includes options chains and consolidated realtime data for eligible authenticated users; no payload was captured in this assessment.
providers.automated_use: Documented authenticated API. Personal-use and applicable data entitlements still apply.
blockers: Requires an account and authentication.
Sandbox delay fails the existing five-second gate.
No actual response or operating reliability was qualified.

providers.title: Alpaca option quote API
providers.authentication: A valid API key or authorized account connection is required.
providers.latency: Official OPRA entitlement differs from the free indicative feed. Free indicative trades are delayed and its quotes are modified.
providers.quote_semantics: The official latest-quote API distinguishes OPRA from indicative pricing. Modified indicative quotes cannot stand in for the actual option book requested here.
providers.automated_use: Documented authenticated market-data API, subject to feed entitlements.
blockers: Requires an account/API authentication.
The free indicative quote stream is not an unmodified actual OPRA book.
No no-account actual BBO entitlement was established.

providers.title: Cboe delayed quotes dashboard
providers.authentication: Public dashboard viewing is available; that is not an automated-feed entitlement.
providers.latency: Delayed dashboard data, not a verified five-second realtime feed.
providers.quote_semantics: Public quote-table presentation does not establish an authorized continuous BBO capture with the required causal clocks and depth.
providers.automated_use: The displayed notice explicitly prohibits automated extraction/download of its quote-table data. No dashboard/API extraction was attempted.
blockers: Automated quote-table extraction is prohibited by the displayed notice.
Delayed data cannot satisfy current five-second admission.
No alternate hidden endpoint or access-control workaround is authorized.

providers.title: ThetaData free entitlement
providers.authentication: Getting-started documentation describes a user-portal API key or account email/password authentication.
providers.latency: The free entitlement covers historical EOD stock/options data, not a free realtime options quote stream.
providers.quote_semantics: A historical EOD report is not a fresh book. Actual quote/depth payloads and publication clocks were not captured or qualified.
providers.automated_use: Documented authenticated product. The current documentation is inconsistent about terminal necessity and some free rate limits, so neither detail is adopted as an integration guarantee.
blockers: The documented free tier does not supply realtime options quotes.
Documented access uses account authentication.
Setup and rate-limit ambiguities require clarification before any separately authorized adapter.

providers.title: Nasdaq Cloud Data Service option chains
providers.authentication: The documented request requires an Authorization Bearer token.
providers.latency: The documented chain route distinguishes realtime and 15-minute-delayed offsets; no anonymous realtime entitlement is established.
providers.quote_semantics: The chain schema documents option identity, bid/ask prices, side sizes, volume and open interest. The listed chain fields alone do not establish per-side quote-event/publication clocks.
providers.automated_use: An official API specification exists, but token access and applicable product/data rights remain prerequisites.
blockers: Not a documented no-account/no-token route.
An actual timestamp-complete payload and fresh entitlement have not been qualified.

providers.title: TradingView official MCP
providers.authentication: An eligible paid plan and OAuth account authorization are required.
providers.latency: Freshness depends on exchange entitlements; a five-second actual option-book feed is not established by the published tool catalogue.
providers.quote_semantics: Published tools cover bars, screening and research; they do not establish the required option BBO price/size/event-clock response.
providers.automated_use: Official MCP access is documented for authenticated eligible users, with per-user rate limits. Public viewing is not an alternative automated extraction licence.
blockers: Requires an account and an eligible paid plan.
Published tools do not establish the required options BBO source.

providers.title: OnClickMedia free historical API
providers.authentication: The free historical API is advertised without account or API key.
providers.latency: The free product is historical EOD options data. Live options appear under custom dedicated offerings, not the free tier.
providers.quote_semantics: Retained Ariadne observations contain historical prices and sizes, but actual quote-event/publication clocks and standard deliverables remain unverified. The provider identifies upstream aggregation and data-quality limits.
providers.automated_use: The provider documents historical API access and requests considerate availability-first collection. Shared throughput is not an SLA. Its educational/research disclaimer excludes realtime trading/financial-decision reliance.
blockers: Free historical EOD observations fail the current five-second gate.
Source timestamps cannot be manufactured from dates or retrieval times.
Public historical access does not establish a reliable realtime feed.

providers.title: Robinhood official authenticated agent tools
providers.authentication: An existing eligible Robinhood account and an explicitly authorized external-agent connection are required. This is not a no-account source.
providers.latency: The official tool list describes realtime option and equity quotes, without establishing a feed SLA or the actual payload field coverage in this assessment.
providers.quote_semantics: Official tools include option chains, instruments, historical bars and realtime quotes. Exact event clocks, displayed sizes and dated liquidity metrics require a separately scoped response qualification.
providers.automated_use: Official authenticated tools also expose account information and real-order operations. A future paper-data adapter must restrict reviewed read tools and must not treat a broad connection as read-only authority.
blockers: Fails the no-account requirement.
No authenticated response was captured or connected for this review.
Any account connection or broader access grant needs separate authorization and field-level qualification.

scope_limitations: No checked source qualified; this is not a claim that no qualifying source can ever exist.
Documentation review does not prove reliability, actual field coverage or a provider SLA.
No delayed, historical, indicative or response-receipt time is relabelled as a fresh exchange quote event.
connection_status: Unimplemented. The existing options-book gate is batch-scoped and does not maintain a durable paper ledger or authorize capital.
future_shared_ledger_requirements: Use the existing account and its shared cash; add zero funding and no automatic top-ups.
Bind an immutable source identity, append-only observation prefix and actual availability clocks; consume displayed depth durably across repeated observations.
Preserve pending work, holdings, approvals, source caps, pauses, and failed/interrupted/uncertain receipts.
Qualify fees, inventory, entry/monthly controls, disposal behavior and migration separately; a gate pass alone is not a funded fill.
With no qualified source, keep entry admission inactive; do not fabricate quotes, relax clocks or replay uncertain work.
